Battleland Elimination Again is the second season of Battleland Elimination. This season started on June 25, 2024. Hosted by Lip Gloss, Seedling, and the new host named Earphone Shotgun, it consisted of 27 (28 as of episode 15) contestants, divided by three teams.

Episode 1 Part 2
*Challenge: Javelin throw
*Winning Team(s): Africa and Asia
*Losing Team(s): Europe
*Eliminated: Cherry Sodapop
Episode 2
*Challenge: Escape the killer
*Killer: Plunger
*Winning Team(s): Asia and Europe
*Losing Team(s): Africa
*Eliminated: Liquid Nitrogen
Episode 3
*Challenge: A numerous-legged race
*Winning Team(s): Africa and Europe
*Losing Team (s): Asia
*Eliminated: Swordy
Episode 4
*Challenge: Complete the patterns in order
*Winning Team(s): Africa and Europe
*Losing Team (s): Asia
*Eliminated: Evry Charecter Fused
Episode 5
*Challenge: Dance fight
*Winning Team(s): Asia and Europe
*Losing Team(s): Africa

Episode 6
*Challenge:''' To pop the other contestants' balloons while protecting your own
*Winning Team(s): Asia and Europe
*Losing Team(s): Africa

Episode 7
*Challenge: Be the last two teams standing in a spaceship
*Winning Team(s): Africa and Asia
*Losing Team(s): Europe
*Eliminated: Diploma
Episode 8
*Challenge: Roll each team's giant ball into the hole
*Winning Team(s): Europe
*Losing Team(s): Africa and Asia
*Eliminated: Gnome
Episode 9
*Challenge: Dive into the ocean and get the treasure chest with scuba gears
*Winning Team(s): Africa and Asia
*Losing Team(s): Europe
*Eliminated: Water Balloon
Episode 10
*Challenge: Keeping each team's flag participating in triathlon consisting of swimming, biking, and finally, running.
*Tiebreaker Challenge: Climb the pole then ring the bell at the top
*Winning Team(s): Asia and Europe
*Losing Team(s): Africa
*Tiebreaker Challenge Winner: Threaty
*Eliminated: Rocket (Lost Tie)
Episode 11
*Challenge: Climb to the top of the 500-step platform and press the button on the very top.
*Winning Team(s): Africa and Asia
*Losing Team(s): Europe
*Eliminated: Water Balloon
Episode 12
*Challenge: Answer the questions but don't answer wrong then will fall into the large swimming pool
*Winning Team(s): Africa and Europe
*Losing Team(s): Asia
*Eliminated: Monarch
Episode 13
*Challenge: Follow and strike Earphone Shotgun's pose
*Winning Team(s): Africa and Europe
